ctx.title: Mookuthi Amman 2 Box Office (Closing Collection): Nayanthara Starrer Concludes Its Run With A Massive Deficit Of 78%
ctx.summary:
Nayanthara's Mookuthi Amman 2 finished its box office run with disastrous collections, earning less than 22 crore net. 
 The post  Mookuthi Amman 2 Box Office (Closing Collection): Nayanthara Starrer Concludes Its Run With A Massive Deficit Of 78%  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Nayanthara’s Mookuthi Amman 2 has wrapped up its theatrical journey at the Indian box office, bringing the curtain down on a run that lasted less than three weeks. Made on a reported budget of 100 crore, the film could not recover even a quarter of its cost and has been a major disappointment. For Nayanthara, it’s the fourth consecutive failure after Patriot, Toxic , and Hi. Keep reading for a detailed closing collection report!
The Tamil action fantasy thriller was theatrically released on November 6, 2026. It received mixed reviews from critics and audiences alike. As a result, the film failed to create urgency among movie buffs and ended its theatrical journey without making any noise.
Mookuthi Amman 2 began its run with 1.88 crore on day 1, a start that was not strong enough to give the film a cushion. The mixed word-of-mouth that followed made things harder, and the film never managed to pick up momentum in the days that followed. By the time it ended its run, the film had collected just 21.54 crore net at the Indian box office. It equals 25.42 crore gross.
As mentioned above, Mookuthi Amman 2 was reportedly made on a budget of 100 crore . Against this cost, it earned only 21.54 crore net, thus making a recovery of just 21.54%. It ended with a deficit of 78.46 crore , or 78.46% , thus securing a flop verdict at the Indian box office, as per Koimoi’s parameters.
It is a highly disappointing result for a film that carried a big-budget tag and the face value of Nayanthara in the lead, and it shows how critical audience reception is for a sequel of this scale, no matter how big the investment behind it. Hopefully, the actress will bounce back strongly with her upcoming films.
